# Results ledger

CSV row numbers are one-based physical records including the header (first data row=2). JSON references name exact fields. Source SHA-256 values identify the exact bytes used. Table2 cells point to explicit patient rows in CROSS_COHORT_SUMMARY.csv, which point to original checkpoint rows. All manuscript scientific numbers come from these entries; formatting/figure numbering and bibliographic years are not experimental results. Values are not rounded in the CSV.
